# Phantom

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-docs-llms.mjs; edit docs/llms-source.txt instead. -->

> The open-source engineering agent workbench. It runs all engineering, manages resources, and coordinates local and cloud fleets through a CLI, an MCP server, and a web console.

Agents: install with `npm install -g @ashlr/phantom`, then run `phm docs --agent --json`. The copy-paste install, JSON commands, and MCP setup are in [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

## Start

- [Ecosystem onboarding](ECOSYSTEM-ONBOARDING.md): `phm onboard --ecosystem --json` detects existing capabilities without values; one explicit grant wires the reviewed bundle and returns per-capability results.

`phm connect` is not available in this checkout. Use `phantom add NAME` in a
trusted terminal for a new Phantom Secrets name; keep credentials out of chat.
Approval cards record consent and do not collect credentials.

- [Phantom](README.md): Doc map for this folder.
- [Quickstart](QUICKSTART.md): Install Phantom, open the console, and make a first turn.
- [Self-hosting](SELF-HOSTING.md): Install, connect MCP, upgrade, and uninstall.
- [User guide](VERSE.md): Console surfaces and shortcuts.
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): TypeScript/ESM CLI and SDK plus a React web console. `phm` and `ashlr` share one launcher.
- [Agent network channels](AGENT-NETWORK-CHANNELS.md): Offline channel inspection, envelope metadata, loop guard and default-deny send policy.
- [Slack bridge](AGENT-NETWORK.md#slack-bridge): Socket Mode mapping of bus topics/threads to Slack channels/threads; `phm channels slack status --json` and dry-run `phm channels slack map --json` are read-only.
- [Agent Bus v2 contract](AGENT-BUS.md#v2): Participants, body kinds, claim keys with overlap rules, and the work feed for every provider. Print it with `ashlr agents bus contract --json`.
- [Agent roster](AGENT-ROSTER.md): Unified live session roster. `phm agents roster --json` and MCP `phm_agent_roster`. Unknown sources stay unknown.
- [Bus threads and task board](BUS-THREADS.md): `phm bus thread|task` shared local board; task claims are real fenced SharedStore queue claims with atomic pre-execution handoff. Cooperative routing labels only, no execution authority.
- [Agent operations](AGENT-OPERATIONS.md): Cold-start checklist for building and operating Phantom from source.
- [Tier-scaled session scope](QUEUE.md#tier-scaled-session-scope): Frontier 40 files / 600 lines; work 15 / 200; mid 8 / 120; fast 2 / 80. One mergeable PR per job, explicit narrower limits preserved. Offline lint JSON and restock dry-run examples.
- [Lane tool parity audit](AGENT-TOOLCHAIN.md#lane-tool-parity-audit-rq-delegate-scope-1): MCP servers supplied by each launch path, unverified lane state and gaps to flag before assigning work.
- [Org responsibility assignment](AGENT-NETWORK.md#assign-responsibilities-without-expanding-authority): Use org show, member opt-in and org plan within contributed limits; proposals and Mason-only actions.
- [Automatic work](AUTOMATIC-OUTCOMES.md): Chat routing and fleet outcomes.
- [Autonomy setup](AUTONOMY-SETUP.md): Dormant macOS autonomy. Status is not activation.
- [Friction loop doctrine](doctrine/FRICTION-LOOP.md): How autonomy work is chosen — delegate everything, find where delegation stops for a human step, remove the step without removing the protection, and measure the signal after merge.

## CLI

- [Apps control](APPS-CONTROL.md): Manage allowlisted desktop apps (`~/.ashlr/apps-allow.json`, empty by default). Commands: `phm apps list|open|quit|focus|status [--json]`. Runs through the desktop adapter only, logs every action to the feed, sends a quit with unsaved work to needs-you.
- [Desktop control](DESKTOPCTL.md): Drive Claude, Codex and Devin desktop apps as interchangeable resources through the `computer_*` tools (`~/.ashlr/desktopctl.json`, off by default). Commands: `phm desktopctl capabilities|status|run <resource> [--json]`. Reports TCC grant state per resource, never prompts for or changes grants; `browser` is read-only.
- [Desktop operator](DESKTOP-OPERATOR.md): Read and drive Phantom, Devin, Codex, Claude, Grok and Cursor on this Mac. Commands: `phm desktop list-apps|windows|focus|read|scroll|type|click|screenshot|doctor [--json]`. Writes post a bus intent first. `phm desktop doctor --json` reports Accessibility and Screen Recording for the `desktop-operator` binary.
- [Drafts](DRAFTS.md): Outbound mail to anyone but you is written as a draft and surfaces as a needs-you item. Commands: `phm drafts list|show|approve|reject --json`. Example: `phm drafts list --status pending --json`. Approve records your decision and does not send.
- [Comms agent](COMMS-AGENT.md): Comms role under the Leader. Commands: `phm comms-agent status|run|drafts --json`. Example: `phm comms-agent status --json`. The router picks the lane. Sends need an owner standing approval.
- [Agent sessions](SESSIONS.md): Resumable sessions modeled on Claude Managed Agents. A session is an agent profile id and version, an environment id and an append-only event log, and each turn is one `phm queue` job. Commands: `phm sessions list|create|show|resume|terminate --json`. Example: `phm sessions show sesn_0123456789abcdef --json`. Statuses: idle, running, rescheduling, terminated.
- [Import scheduled routines](VERSE.md#automations-315): `ashlr automations import --from routines.json --dry-run --json` previews disabled imports from a local JSON array.

- [Docs Radar](RADAR.md): Public source list, bounded unauthenticated reads, private snapshots and offline diffs. Commands: `phm radar list|run|diff --json`. Individual fetch failures are warnings; the last successful snapshot is retained.
- [Human observe](OBSERVE.md): One `phm observe --json` snapshot for roster, sensor headroom, resource coordination, pull headlines, bottlenecks, and human steps. Unknown stays unknown.
- [World model](WORLD.md): `phm world --json` is the cached `ashlr.world-model/v1` snapshot the scheduler reads. `phm world get <path> --json` is the tick read. Unknown is never zero. `phm context --for-agent <lane> --json` is the under-4KB brief. `phm claim acquire <work-key> --lane <lane> --json` refuses a live claim or open pull on that key.

- [CLI reference](CLI-REFERENCE.md): Generated from `phm --help` and `phm help --all`. The checkout is the authority.
- [CLI docs](cli.md): Regenerated from `phm --help` by `scripts/generate-cli-docs.mjs`. Do not edit by hand.
- [CLI contracts](AGENT-CLI-CONTRACTS.md): Command-level guarantees.

## MCP and agents

- [Full copy-paste reference](llms-full.txt): Install, JSON commands, and MCP setup for Claude, Cursor, and Codex.
- [Fleet MCP onramp](FLEET-MCP-ONRAMP.md): Read-only fleet MCP server. Add the stdio entry to a client config.
- [Companions](COMPANIONS.md): Phantom Secrets, Locus, and Lexicon are installed separately. They are not bundled.
- [Agent toolchain](AGENT-TOOLCHAIN.md): Companion MCP servers declared for agents working in this repo.
- [Agent-native quickstart](AGENT-NATIVE-QUICKSTART.md): Use the desktop `/verse/` console as the visibility surface.
- [Plugins](PLUGINS.md): Extend Phantom without forking.

## Fleet

- Parked dependency gates: `phm fleet parked --json` lists `PARKED-DEP` rows and `unmetDeps` (gate ids not yet `MERGED` in `jobs.jsonl`). Restock auto-unparks when every gate id is merged; unpark does not merge. See [Mac queue scripts](../contrib/mac/README.md).
- [Channel guide](CHANNELS.md): Six inbound channels — `phm channels add <kind>` writes config only; `phm channels status --json` reads the rollup.
- [iMessage intake](IMESSAGE.md): `phm imessage doctor --json` checks Full Disk Access, sqlite3 and config; `phm imessage poll --json` is a counts-only dry run, `--apply` receipts allowlisted messages as channel `imessage` (replies are recorded, not sent).
- [Fleet brief-send](BRIEF-SEND.md): Morning (7:30 ET) and overnight (22:30 ET) fleet briefs with a needs-you list of at most 5 items; `phm fleet brief-send --json` dry-runs, `--apply` sends.
- [Fleet API](FLEET-API.md): Loopback HTTP projections for desktop, phone, and Leader coordination.
- [Cloud lane](CLOUD.md): Claude Code cloud sessions from chat, Command, or CLI.
- [Add a computer in 60 seconds](add-a-computer.md): install, join, choose capabilities, verify, and leave.
- Node router: `phm node join|pull|plan|status --json`, guide in `docs/NODE-ROUTER.md`. Nodes advertise caps, jobs carry an owner scope and a fenced lease, auth stays local.
- [Drive](DRIVE.md): Mac queue supervisor. Serial ticks, worker reaping, and READY job admission.
- [Daemon tick phases](daemon-tick-phases.md): Bounded resident tick stages — per-phase status/duration/error and tick outcomes via `phm daemon status --json | jq .tick.phases`.
- [Disk maintenance](DISK-MAINT.md): `phm disk-maint [--apply] [--json]` reclaims rebuildable bytes by class; `phm disk-maint schedule` installs the daily job. Dry run by default; the protect-list (`~/.codex*`, model weights, Docker, client trees, secrets) is unconditional.
- [Hub reference](HUB-REFERENCE.md): Universe, resource pools, and the legacy fleet. Compatibility identifiers stay.
- [Console layout](CONSOLE-LAYOUT.md): One set of width breakpoints for the web console. Compact phone, laptop, and wide-monitor views of the same live state.

- [Subscription capacity](RESOURCE-EVIDENCE.md#publish-subscription-capacity): Run `phm capacity publish --json` on each node with its own local auth; usage metadata only. Resident daemons publish at startup and on a background timer.

- [Route hysteresis](ROUTE-HYSTERESIS.md): 60-minute pool residency, immutable launched jobs, two moves per six hours, ROUTE_HOLD and phm route explain --json.

- [Durable memory](MEMORY.md): `phm memory add|list|search|forget --json`; preferences, doctrine and facts as markdown under `~/.phantom/memory/`, secret-shaped text refused.

- [Connector profiles](CONNECTORS.md): `phm connectors add|list|remove|show|import --json`; metadata and Phantom Secrets references; `run <id> --scope <scope> --tool <tool> --lane <lane> --json -- <args>` denies execution pending Security review.
- [Chief-of-staff intake](COS.md): Durable channel jobs, JSON command contracts and approved result delivery.
- [Release autonomy audit](RELEASE-AUTONOMY.md): Once wired into the CLI, `phm release autonomy --json` inventories release gates with read-only GitHub calls. Use `--repo locus --md` for a single Markdown report.

- [Desktop update status](../DESKTOP.md#background-update-discovery-and-local-status): `phm app update status --json` reports the inspected local stage, host deferral and lease counts; unknown identities remain null.

- [Agent network](AGENT-NETWORK.md): SSH multi-Mac node pool; first join needs explicit aliases and owner, repeat node join --json reuses config; RAM/disk pressure admission, local auth, mobile control only, split-brain fencing and primary-only publication.

- [Repository ranking](REPO-RANK.md): `phm repos rank --json`, `phm repos rank --recompute --json` and `phm repos rank proposals --json`; daily local evidence, manual enrollment, read-only restock weights.

- [PR triage](PR-TRIAGE.md): read-only open PR verdicts and JSON schema.

- [oMLX dispatcher lane](../contrib/mac/README.md): memory-capped `omlx` pool, `127.0.0.1` health only, `phm lanes --json`; Security combined RETUNE pin required before installation.
